text:
A singer sings two notes. The first note is louder and lower in pitch than the second note.
Which statement about the two notes is correct?
A
The first note has a larger amplitude and a larger frequency than the second note.
B
The first note has a larger amplitude and a smaller frequency than the second note.
C
The first note has a smaller amplitude and a larger frequency than the second note.
D
The first note has a smaller amplitude and a smaller frequency than the second note.

options.label: A
options.text: The first note has a larger amplitude and a larger frequency than the second note.

options.label: B
options.text: The first note has a larger amplitude and a smaller frequency than the second note.

options.label: C
options.text: The first note has a smaller amplitude and a larger frequency than the second note.

options.label: D
options.text: The first note has a smaller amplitude and a smaller frequency than the second note.
